# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

[][28]
[][29]
[][30]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]

* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

## Company Profile

**Alfamart is a joint venture between SM and Alfamart Indonesia, one of the leading minimarket chain
operators with more than 20,000 stores in Indonesia.**

Launched in the Philippines in 2014 with its first minimart in Trece Martires, Cavite, the brand has
rapidly expanded across Luzon—including Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Metro Manila, Pampanga, and
Pangasinan. In June 2024, marking a decade of local operations, we celebrated a major milestone with
the opening of our

**2,000th Philippine store**.

Our stores offer everything you need for your home: frozen meats, fresh vegetables, canned goods,
personal care items, and daily essentials at affordable prices. Because our locations are nested
right within neighborhoods, customers save both time and transportation costs by skipping long trips
to distant supermarkets.

As we grow, local communities thrive alongside us. We generate widespread economic opportunities by
sourcing local contractors for construction, partnering with Filipino MSMEs for store-space rentals,
and securing inventory from regional vendors. Most importantly, every new store opening creates
immediate job opportunities and long-term career training for members of the local community.

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust

  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

Henan GP Chemicals Co.,Ltd and it's brother company Henan EME Technology Co.,Ltd and DEXI CHEMICALS
CO.,LIMITED are the professional and comprehensive distributor of chemical products in China. the
company provides business-to-business distribution solutions for industrial and specialty chemicals
globally. With over 1,000 products and a highly diverse supplier base, GP CHEMICALS offers
one-stop-shop solutions to about 2,000 customers in worldwide. GP Chemicals is one of the leading
ketones, acetates, amines, glycol ethers, arylates, tertiary butyl acetate, tetrahydrofuran, TDI,
acetonitrile, N-Methyl pyrrolidone, methyl-1, 3-propanediol(MPO), PTMEG, PBT suppliers and also a
professional such manufacturer in China. Welcome to buy bulk chemical products from us.

GP Chemicals purchases and stores large-scale quantities of industrial and specialty chemicals from
various suppliers. With value-added services such as just-in-time delivery, product mixing,
formulation, repackaging, inventory management, drum return handling as well as technical services,
GP CHEMICALS aims to be the partner of choice for our customers and suppliers.

# A sustainable future through innovative chemistry

##### Our vision is to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company

With a vision to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company, we deliver customer
value through innovative chemistry that supports the energy transition and drives sustainable
progress.

Our specialty chemicals reduce the impact of current transportation modes, enable e-mobility,
support decarbonisation, improve industrial efficiency and much more, helping our customers solve
complex challenges and succeed in a changing world.

### Customer Centric Innovation

We provide innovative solutions that solve the complex challenges faced by our customers today

[Explore our Customer Centric Innovation][48]

### Sustainability

Working with our value chain partners to achieve sustainability ambitions

[Learn about our Sustainability approach][49]

### Safety

Safety, Security and the Environment are our highest priorities

[Safety is our number one priority][50]

# Omya ranked #7 globally in chemical distribution

##### Our combined businesses, Omya Specialty Materials and Omya Performance Polymer Distribution,
##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors
##### listing.

[Read more][248]
[Omya Specialty Materials Hero Image]

# Omya Specialty Materials

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.
  [OSM header]
  ][251]
* [
  
  ## Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
  
  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.
  [OPPD_Header_image]
  ][252]

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

### Omya facts and figures

At Omya, we take a long-term approach to business, ensuring sustainability and growth for both our
company and our customers. Here are some key facts and figures about Omya:

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

# Creating and DeliveringSustainable Chemistryfor everyday moments

## Get to know PVS

What we provide touches everyone in some unique way. That’s why at PVS, Chemistry For Daily Life
isn’t just our tagline... it’s our promise.

We do more than your average chemical company. We’re a global manufacturer, distributor, and
marketer of high-quality products and provide reliable transportation services to our suppliers and
customers.

We provide sustainable solutions around the world to diverse industries that include electronics,
manufacturing, steel, agricultural, fine chemicals, metal finishing, water treatment, and food
processing. We’re committed to 100% customer satisfaction and creating a circular economy to
maximize the use and reuse of our planet’s resources.

*That’s * Chemistry For Daily Life.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.
